value: Your mind becomes too focused to be slowed, paralyzed or confused for 12+1d12 turns.
Coats all your melee weapons with poison for 18+1d18 turns.
Confuses a single monster; more effective against animals.
Speeds up digestion to increase regeneration of hitpoints for the next 5+1d3 turns (or until hungry).
Instantly kills any monster in line of sight with less than four times the player's level in hitpoints, also hurting the player.  Other monsters are unharmed.
